title: Toggle Mods
description: This Project lets you toggle mods on and off.
body:
Toggle Mods gives you total control over your Fabric modpack without ever having to leave the game. Tired of manually moving .jar files just to test a performance boost or disable a glitchy mod? Do it all from the title screen or while you play.

Features

Live Toggle: Enable or disable any mod in your folder with a single click. Filter the list by All, Enabled, or Disabled to quickly find what you need.

One-Click Relaunch: Uses an advanced JVM-cloning process to restart Minecraft instantly. It bypasses the launcher, keeping your settings and window focus exactly where they were.

Dependency Awareness: The mod tracks which mods depend on each other. If something else requires a mod you're trying to disable, it will tell you instead of letting you break your load order.

In-Game Modrinth Browser: Browse and download mods directly from inside the game. The browser only shows versions compatible with your exact running Minecraft version — incompatible mods are grayed out automatically. Already-installed mods are marked so you never download the same mod twice.

Preset System: Save your current mod configuration as a named preset and restore it any time. Great for switching between performance, content, and testing setups without any manual file management.

In-Game Access: Access the manager via a dedicated button on the Title Screen or a global keybind (Default: Right Shift).

Fully Customizable: Don't like Right Shift? Change the keybind in the standard Minecraft Controls menu.

How it Works

When you toggle mods and hit "Apply," Toggle Mods handles the file management for you. It then clones the current Java environment, spins up a fresh instance of Minecraft with your updated mod list, and shuts down the old one. It's the fastest way to manage a heavy modpack.

Usage

Open the menu using the button on the Title Screen or press Right Shift while in-game.
Toggle the mods you want to load or unload. Use the filter row to narrow the list.
Optionally browse Modrinth to download new mods, or load a saved preset.
Click Apply & Relaunch.
Watch your game refresh itself automatically.
Technical Note

This mod requires the Fabric Loader. Because it creates a new Java process, you may see a brief moment where the window closes before the new one appears — this is normal and ensures a clean load of your new mod configuration. Downloaded mods are saved to your mods_disabled folder so they're ready to enable on the next launch.
